purpose: One-time read-only successor snapshot that captures value-free pagination field presence/type diagnostics when the Cloudflare billing-history page contract fails, while retaining bounded redacted billing-history evidence.
supersedes: No prior authority. The consumed V0.1 one-time authority remains immutable and must not be rerun.

execution.history_check: Require exactly one V0.2 diagnostic workflow run total; it must be this first-attempt main dispatch.
execution.pagination: Sequential pages only while documented V4 pagination metadata is valid; stop immediately on invalid metadata and report field presence/type only.

persist_only: page and result counts when validated
per-field pagination metadata presence, JSON type, and nonnegative-integer validity when invalid
action, type, status and currency categories

allowed_operations: One GitHub Actions workflow-history metadata request.
At most ten sequential read-only Cloudflare account billing-history requests.
Secret-free short-retention report artifact and Actions summary.
forbidden_operations: Any rerun, retry, redirect following, fallback endpoint, status filtering, or request beyond the page/item cap.
Persisting raw response, account identity, item/invoice identifiers, hosted invoice URLs, descriptions, or invalid pagination values.
Invoice/payment-method/profile/member access beyond fields returned by the specified read-only history endpoint.
Any create, update, delete, purchase, plan change, D1/R2 access, provider access, training, holdout access, Cloud Paper execution, or schedule activation.
Any conclusion that this history snapshot alone proves zero total account/project cost or all current/future writers are covered.
